title: Well-posedness, mean attractors and invariant measures of stochastic discrete long-wave-short-wave resonance equations driven by locally Lipschitz nonlinear noise
summary: This paper is devoted to investigating the random dynamics of stochastic discrete long-wave-short-wave resonance equations, which are characterized by the following features: $(1)$ the equations contain locally Lipschitz nonlinear coupling terms $u_mv_m$ and $(B(|u(t)|^2))_m$ for $m\in \mathbb{Z}$; $(2)$ the nonlinear coefficients of noises satisfy local Lipschitz conditions; and $(3)$ the system couples real and complex equations and is infinite-dimensional.
